variables.name: USUBJID
variables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
variables.description: Identifier used to uniquely identify a subject across all studies for all applications or submissions involving the product.

variables.name: SESEQ
variables.label: Sequence Number
variables.description: Sequence number given to ensure uniqueness of subject records within a domain. Should be assigned to be consistent chronological order.

variables.name: ETCD
variables.label: Element Code
variables.description: 1. ETCD (the companion to ELEMENT) is limited to 8 characters and does not have special character restrictions. These values should be short for ease of use in programming, but it is not expected that ETCD will need to serve as a variable name. \n 2. If an encountered element differs from the planned element to the point that it is considered a new element, then use "UNPLAN" as the value for ETCD to represent this element.

variables.name: ELEMENT
variables.label: Description of Element
variables.description: The name of the element. If ETCD has a value of "UNPLAN", then ELEMENT should be null.

variables.name: TAETORD
variables.label: Planned Order of Element within Arm
variables.description: Number that gives the planned order of the element within the subject's assigned trial arm.

variables.name: EPOCH
variables.label: Epoch
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C99079
variables.description: Epoch associated with the element in the planned sequence of elements for the arm to which the subject was assigned.

variables.name: SESTDTC
variables.label: Start Date/Time of Element
variables.description: Start date/time for an element for each subject.

variables.name: SEENDTC
variables.label: End Date/Time of Element
variables.description: End date/time for an element for each subject.

variables.name: SESTDY
variables.label: Study Day of Start of Element
variables.description: Study day of start of element relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC.

variables.name: SEENDY
variables.label: Study Day of End of Element
variables.description: Study day of end of element relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC.

variables.name: SEUPDES
variables.label: Description of Unplanned Element
variables.description: Description of what happened to the subject during an unplanned element. Used only if ETCD has the value of "UNPLAN".
